answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a stake that grows along a reputation vine: every verified job adds a small bond, so trust compounds like a vine climbing toward a summit, while a fake identity starts at the base with nothing. A raven-style auditor randomly samples completed work, checks it against ground truth, and slashes the stake of any agent caught lying. Ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand stakes, and one failed audit wipes each one, so the attack price scales with its size while honest agents keep climbing.
